card.name: Linking words in drug lists
card.fires_on: Small linking words, commas or spaces right after a drug name or number in a drug list or dose phrase, such as 'tamsulosin or', 'dutasteride,' and 'to 2 weeks'. Also partway through tadalafil.

modes.label: Between listed drugs
modes.description: An 'or', 'and' or comma joining drug names in a list of related drugs.
modes.example: The administration of dutasteride in combination with tamsulosin<< or>> terazosin has no effect on

modes.label: Before a number
modes.description: The space just before a number in a dose or interval phrase.
modes.example: The recommended titration interval is 1 to<< >>2 weeks.

modes.label: Inside an organization name
modes.description: A small word like 'the' or 'of' within a department or title.
modes.example: chief of the Section Neuropsychology in<< the>> Department of Neuro-Oncology

card.writes: It suppresses 'rem' spellings, so it adds no clear help for the next word.
card.plain: It fires on small joining words and spaces between drug names and numbers in drug lists and dose phrases.
